node.statement: Under the antecedent of node 1, lem-stage1-smooth-unitary-atlas supplies on calU the same smooth embedded graph atlas as its C^1 atlas, with no point or first derivative changed; B^{calH}_delta(J) is an open subset of the finite-dimensional real vector space calH, so calU x B^{calH}_delta(J) has the product smooth structure, while S_delta is an open subset of the finite-dimensional ambient space by lem-stage1-polar-retraction and has its open-subset smooth structure.
